jobs.title: Product & Commercial Photographer
jobs.summary: Create polished product and commercial photography for brands, campaigns and ecommerce content. Strong freshers with quality portfolios and experienced photographers are welcome to apply.
jobs.descriptionMd:
We are looking for Product & Commercial Photographers to create professional imagery across Fixen Media, selected brands and client projects.

This role may involve product photography, ecommerce shoots, campaign imagery, fashion or lifestyle content, commercial brand photography and supporting visual assets for advertising and digital platforms.

We welcome candidates from different experience levels. Strong freshers with a thoughtful portfolio are encouraged to apply, while more experienced photographers may take greater ownership of lighting setups, shoot planning, styling coordination and complex commercial assignments.

We value lighting, composition, consistency and attention to detail more than equipment ownership alone.
jobs.responsibilitiesMd:
- Photograph products and commercial subjects according to campaign or brand requirements.
- Plan compositions, backgrounds, lighting and shooting setups.
- Create clean ecommerce and catalogue imagery where required.
- Produce creative campaign and promotional photography.
- Work with models, products, props or locations depending on the project.
- Maintain consistent exposure, color and visual style across a shoot.
- Coordinate with creative directors, designers, stylists and production teams.
- Select and organize usable images efficiently.
- Perform or support basic retouching and image preparation.
- Prepare images for web, social media, advertising and print use.
- Maintain organized files and backups.
- More experienced candidates may lead complete photography setups and commercial-shoot execution.
jobs.requirementsMd:
- Strong understanding of composition, exposure and lighting.
- Working knowledge of DSLR or mirrorless camera operation.
- Understanding of aperture, shutter speed, ISO and focal length.
- Ability to create clean and consistent product imagery.
- Basic understanding of artificial and natural lighting.
- Attention to color, texture and detail.
- Ability to follow a creative brief.
- Ability to work collaboratively during productions.
- Basic image-selection and post-processing knowledge.
- A photography portfolio, academic project or other demonstrable work.

Formal professional experience is not mandatory for applicants with strong practical ability.
jobs.niceToHaveMd:
- Studio-lighting experience.
- Fashion or apparel photography.
- Ecommerce photography.
- Food or lifestyle photography.
- Commercial campaign experience.
- Adobe Lightroom or Photoshop experience.
- Advanced retouching skills.
- Tethered shooting experience.
- Product styling experience.
- Experience preparing images for print and ecommerce.
- Basic video-shooting ability.
benefits: Work on real product and commercial shoots
Exposure to fashion, ecommerce and brand campaigns
Chance to collaborate with creative and production teams
Opportunity to build a diverse commercial portfolio

questions.label: Why do you want to work with us?
Share up to three product or commercial photography projects that best represent your work.
For one of the projects above, explain how you approached lighting, composition and final image selection.
Which cameras, lenses, lighting equipment and editing tools are you comfortable using?
Have you worked on product or ecommerce photography with consistent shots across multiple products?
How would you approach photographing a reflective, glossy or difficult product?
How comfortable are you with image retouching and color correction?
Do you have experience directing models, styling products or coordinating a shoot?
